0.04.gait_definition: Per env and foot over its window (from 1 s to the first episode's end or the clip's end). Foot: the centre of the foot collider (adapter's feet), its height taken above the task's collision surface (adapter.ground_height; 0 on flat ground): the highest surface point under the foot's footprint (adapter's feet_footprint: its bounding-box corners; else straight below the centre), so a foot standing across a step edge is on the upper tread. cadence_hz: peak of the Hann-windowed FFT of the mean-removed foot height (zero-padded to >= 16x, searched in 0.5-10 Hz), i.e. gait cycles per second of that foot. apex_m: 95th percentile of the foot height above its stance height (median height while in contact). slip_mps: median horizontal speed of the foot between consecutive frames that are both in contact. air_frac: fraction of frames not in contact. touchdowns_hz: contact onsets after at least 2 frames in the air, per second (a terrain-independent cross-check of the cadence; needs feet_contact). Contact: the adapter's feet_contact (the task's touch sensor > 1 N), else within 15 mm of the window's lowest height. speed_mps: pelvis horizontal path / window time; stride_m: speed / mean cadence (ground covered per gait cycle). Summary: medians over envs whose first episode did not terminate and that walk (speed >= 0.15 m/s).
